query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Read reference documents and a spreadsheet, discover fiscal-period logic from available workspace sources, update spreadsheet formulas, and create a summary worksheet.
query_ground_truth.intent: Search workspace sources to understand the specific rules and definitions for fiscal periods.

requirement_groups.purpose: Search workspace files to find fiscal-period logic sources

results.execution_guidance: Found 2 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Free and open-source integrated Enterprise Resource Planning software built on Frappe Framework
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=erpnext. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="erpnext") to create a connection BEFORE executing any erpnext tools.

ERPNEXT_GET_FISCAL_YEAR.description: Tool to get fiscal year information for a given date in ERPNext. Use when you need to determine which fiscal year a specific date falls into or retrieve fiscal year boundaries.

date.description: Date to check for fiscal year in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, the current date will be used.

company.description: Company name to get fiscal year for. If not provided, the default company will be used.

ERPNEXT_GET_VALUE.description: Tool to get specific field value(s) from a document in ERPNext. Use when you need to retrieve one or more field values without loading the entire document.

name.description: The specific document name/ID to retrieve. Use this when you know the exact document identifier. Cannot be used together with filters parameter.

doctype.description: The DocType (document type) to query. Examples include 'User', 'Customer', 'Sales Invoice', 'Item', etc.

filters.description: Filter conditions as JSON string to match documents (e.g., '{"status": "Open"}' or '{"email": "user@example.com"}'). Returns the first matching document. Cannot be used together with name parameter.

fieldname.description: The field name(s) to retrieve. For multiple fields, provide a comma-separated list (e.g., 'full_name,email').

time_info.message:
- This is time in UTC timezone. Get timezone from user if you needed.
          - Always use this time info to construct parameters for tool calls appropriately even when the tool call requires relative times like 'last week', 'last 24 hours', 'today', 'tomorrow' etc.
          - Do not hallucinate the time or timezone by yourself.
